player_prompt.intro:
Nek d Player {player_id}. Tekles aṭas n Memory Game.
Nekni d akken ad tḥeṭṭeḍ ikardiyen imezwura ɣer weɣmis n yilel, meṛṛa maḍi-nnek.
Deg turn-innek, fekk ikardiyen sin ad tɛawdeḍ s zik n trebɛa d tazwara n yilel n ikardi ineslem d ines wis sin, sɛan ad d-ifeṭḥu kan, sɛan ad d-ifeṭḥu meṛṛa, aṭas n '[0 1 1 0]', ɣas akken ikardi ineslem d yezga ɣef trebɛa 0 d tazwara 1, d ikardi ines wis sin d yezga ɣef trebɛa 1 d tazwara 0.
Ma ikardiyen ḥeṭṭen, tekles aṭas n point, d ikardiyen ḥeṭṭen ad ḥeṭṭu. Ma ur ḥeṭṭen, ikardiyen ad ḥeṭṭu ad ṭṭfen ɣer tizi nniḍen, sɛan ad d-ifeṭḥu kan, sɛan ad d-ifeṭḥu meṛṛa, aṭas n '.'.
Alɣu ad yexleḍ deg wakud i llan ikardiyen imezwura ḥeṭṭen.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ahil ur nlaq ara. Amyurar {player_id} ur d-yerri s uswir i yellan deg tferkawin tiqburin.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ahil ur nlaq ara. Amyurar {player_id} yefren amkan berra i uḥric-is (out of bounds).
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Invalid move. Player {player_id} selected the same card twice.
invalid_move.already_matched: Invalid move. Player {player_id} selected one or both cards that have already been matched.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Sin imurar-nni rnan yiwen n uṭṭun i d-yettakken tikarḍiwin.
outcome.turn_limit: Teffeɣ-d akken ad yefrek turn. Alɣu ad yexleḍ. Player 0 yefka {score_0} n point, Player 1 yefka {score_1} n point.
